evidence.decision_implication: Resolve the disagreement between individual guides before prioritizing this target.
evidence.essentiality_limit: Cancer-cell knockout fitness; not an automatic veto for partial suppression in MSCs. Aggregates count screen rows, not unique cell lines.
evidence.label: Published screen hit; guide disagreement to resolve
evidence.published_context: The supplement reports a positive no-IL6 screen effect. This is statistical evidence from the source screen, not independent biological validation.
evidence.source_location: Results: genome-wide CRISPRi screen and Fig. 1; supplementary Table S1

external_context.matrix_warning: GEO counts and the published supplement differ. Supplementary beta/FDR are external context, not ground truth for this exploratory estimator.

limitations: Exploratory full-data reanalysis; no independent held-out evaluation or measured agent advantage.
Approximate log2 count enrichment, not MAGeCK MLE beta scores, a reproduced publication analysis, p-values or FDR.
Positive enrichment means relative persistence/expansion of guide-bearing cells; it does not prove rejuvenation, preserved cell identity, safety or longevity.
Negative enrichment may reflect impaired cell fitness; count depletion does not uniquely establish a senescence mechanism.
Two measured repeats only; guide leave-one-out is a sensitivity check, not new biological replication.
Operational thresholds are explicit heuristics, not calibrated probabilities or gene-level statistical significance.
All pooled measurements already exist; no wet-lab experiment or cost savings were demonstrated.

missing_endpoints: senescence phenotype for this complete candidate set

parameters.baseline_filter: same guides pass baseline-count threshold in both D0 repeats
parameters.gene_summary: median of guide mean log2 enrichments across two repeats
parameters.normalization: total library depth to geometric-mean depth, then non-targeting median centering per contrast
